intro: Nashville's public sauna scene is a cluster of social sauna and cold plunge studios, all within about two miles of downtown: Framework's indoor-outdoor flagship in Wedgewood-Houston and its open-air Backyard in East Nashville, Lolu's 40-person sauna and saltwater cold pool on Main Street, and Ritual's community sauna on Porter Road. None of the four states its heat source, and no public wood-fired sauna was found. The many infrared-only studios in town, and private-room bathhouses such as Holiday Salon & Bathhouse, are not listed.

venues.name: Framework (Wedgewood-Houston Flagship)
venues.drop_in_price: $35 weekday / $55 weekend single session; $79 first-timer offer (the location page calls it a week of unlimited sessions)
venues.cold_plunge: Plunge tubs: the location page lists thirteen indoor and outdoor tubs, solo and shared (homepage: 35-60°F); the membership page lists 9 tubs at 38-60°F
venues.schedule: Mixed, adults only; swimsuit required. Hours in the site footer: Mon and Wed-Fri 6am-8pm, Sat 8am-6pm, Sun 8am-7pm (implies closed Tuesday); the FAQ still says weekdays 7am-7pm and weekends 8am-6pm, so check before going. Walk-ins accepted, booking ahead encouraged.
venues.notes: Traditional saunas at 194°F per the location page, which counts seven (social and silent zones plus a patio sauna); the membership page counts three. Towels, lockers, showers and water included. Shower before the sauna and plunge. Phones stay in lockers. Private rooms for up to four and a second-floor café cost extra. On-site parking. Membership also covers the East Nashville Backyard.

venues.name: Framework (East Nashville Backyard)
venues.drop_in_price: $29 weekday / $39 weekend single session per the location FAQ (the membership page lists $25 / $35); $79 for 5 sessions first-timer offer
venues.cold_plunge: Four outdoor cold tubs, solo and two-person, 40-60°F
venues.schedule: Mixed, adults only; swimsuit required. Hours in the site footer: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 7am-7pm, Sat-Sun 8am-6pm (implies closed Wednesday); the FAQ says Mon-Thu 7am-7pm, so check before going.
venues.notes: Fully outdoor studio with one 190°F social sauna for up to twelve. Indoor locker rooms and restrooms; towels and water included. On-site parking. A Backyard membership does not cover the Flagship.

venues.name: Lolu
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown (drop-ins, credit packs and unlimited memberships are offered, but prices are only shown in the booking system and app)
venues.session_length: 75 minutes (Free Flow, unguided); 60 minutes (Guided class with breathwork)
venues.schedule: Book a timed Free Flow session or Guided class on the schedule page or in the Lolu app. Arrive 5 minutes early; guided classes may not admit late arrivals. Swimwear or activewear. Late cancel (under 90 minutes) $15; no-show $20. Opening hours Unknown on the site.
venues.notes: 40-person traditional dry sauna; guided classes take up to 35 people. Towel provided; changing rooms with lockers, tea lounge, coffee cart and outdoor courtyard. A private sauna and plunge suite for up to four is by appointment. On-site lot plus street parking on North 8th Street and Neill Avenue. Sign the waiver before the first visit. Sauna temperature Unknown.

venues.name: Ritual Community Sauna & Wellness Space
venues.drop_in_price: $25 Community Sauna single session; add cold plunge for $7; 5-pass Community $95 (2-month expiry)
venues.cold_plunge: Cold plunge, $7 add-on to a Community Sauna session (location and temperature Unknown)
venues.schedule: Book by appointment through Mindbody (first visit needs registration and a waiver). Hours Unknown on the venue site; a local guide (citysaunas.com, Sept 2026) lists Mon-Thu 8am-8pm and Fri-Sun 9am-6pm. Gender policy and swimwear rules Unknown.
venues.notes: Shared traditional Finnish-style sauna built from aspen and red cedar. Private Solo Studio (infrared + traditional, 1 person, $40) and Lounge Studio (infrared, 2-4 people, $55 for two) are also offered; only the community sauna qualifies as a drop-in here. Memberships from $75/month. Sauna temperature Unknown.
